summary: Replace host Docker socket mount with rootless DinD sidecar in the local pipeline integration test stack. Zero orchestrator code changes — DockerClient already supports DOCKER_HOST via environment variable. Work is compose configuration, test fixture updates for image loading into DinD, and volume path adjustments.

findings.detail: DockerClient (orchestrator/docker_client.py:95-109) already supports DOCKER_HOST env var. Setting DOCKER_HOST=tcp://dind:2375 requires no code changes.

ContainerSpawner (container_spawner.py:55) reads EGG_ISOLATED_NETWORK from environment. Test compose already overrides this to match test network names. DinD-spawned containers need to join this network for gateway connectivity.
Mock-sandbox is built as alpine+curl (~5MB). Transfer via docker save | docker load is fast and validated on target host.
Named volumes (state, worktrees, certs) can be shared across compose services including DinD. The EGG_HOST_REPO_MAP must reference DinD-internal paths instead of host paths.

DinD's Docker daemon may not see networks created by the outer Docker daemon. DinD-spawned containers may not be able to directly join outer compose networks. This is the highest-risk area and needs early validation.

recommendation.key_risk: Network bridging between DinD-spawned containers and the gateway. Must be validated in Phase 1 before proceeding.
